subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: Working w/ Riot Games & EA | [COMPANY] La Forge
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I came across [COMPANY]'s research with La Forge & [SENDER] Clark's initiative to build a federated data mesh model across the company, so thought I'd reach out since we're working w/ some of your peers at Riot Games & EA on similar projects. 

We're primarily partnering to democratize access to data with the goal of facilitating the adoption of AI/ML, specifically multimodal AI (text, video, audio, etc.), into products. This includes leveraging sophisticated multimodal data visualization and curation techniques, as well as accelerating R&D efforts by enabling easy testing and monitoring of new projects and ideas.

I've been following [COMPANY] for a while, so I'd love to chat and get your candid feedback on what we're building here at Encord. Would you be open to a quick 20-minute catch-up in the coming weeks? Wednesdays and Thursdays work best for me.

text:

Heard great things about your work on model training at [COMPANY]- so wanted to invite you to an intimate dinner our co-founders, [SENDER] & [SENDER], will be hosting an intimate dinner for AI leaders in Seattle - we'd love for you to join if you're interested / can make it!

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Thursday, May 29th at 6:30 PM- 9:30PM Location: Aerlume Seattle Guests: A select group of ~20 CxOs & technical leaders from leading VC-backed scale-ups working with computer vision. Confirmed attendees include leaders of. Standard AI, Retrocausal AI, Walmart. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. Would you be interested in joining us?
